sources.content: Policy Circle says a woman weighing a job has to compare her expected wages against daycare, domestic help and travel costs. sources.title: Maternity Benefits and Crèche Obligations Under India's Labour Codes: An Employer Compliance Guide for 2026
sources.retrieval_method: web_search_tool_summary_multi (summary across several results; per-page attribution not confirmed; verify at URL)
sources.content: Under Section 67 of the SS Code, any establishment with fifty or more employees must provide a creche within a distance the Central Government prescribes, separately or as part of common facilities. The requirement to provide crèche facilities for establishments employing fifty (50) or more employees is retained, with operational flexibility permitting shared or outsourced arrangements subject to prescribed standards. The Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026 let an employer pay a creche allowance instead of running a facility. That option requires an agreement with the negotiating union or council, or with a majority of employees where no such body exists.
